 'BTS THE CITY ARIRANG SINGAPORE' unveils full schedule for fireworks, drone shows, fan events & more
 SPINS 
 8.4K 
 Estimated:   reading 
 Words by Hidzir Junaini 
 First published: 10 November 2026 
 Last updated: 10 November 2026 
 News 
 Gigs 
 Events 
 Singapore is gearing up for a month-long celebration of BTS , and fans now have a clearer picture of what to expect when BTS THE CITY ARIRANG SINGAPORE takes over the island this December.
 Following the initial announcement in October , HYBE has unveiled the programme details on 10 November , revealing dates, timings, and locations for an extensive lineup of fan experiences taking place from 1 to 31 December .
 The celebration will feature spectacular light displays, fireworks, drone shows, interactive installations, themed merchandise, food collaborations, and nightlife events, coinciding with BTS' four sold-out concerts at the National Stadium on 17, 19, 20, and 22 December .
 View this post on Instagram 
 A post shared by Singapore Tourism Board (@stb_sg) 
 Among the biggest highlights is the BTS THE CITY ARIRANG Light & Music Showcase at Jewel Changi Airport , where the iconic Rain Vortex will come alive with music and lights twice daily at 8 PM and 9 PM from 1 to 26 December . Fans can also explore a welcome experience featuring photo opportunities and media installations throughout Jewel.
 Meanwhile, Gardens by the Bay will present the BTS THE CITY Supertrees Light & Music Experience from 12 to 22 December , with nightly performances from 9:35 PM to 9:50 PM. Free viewing areas will be available at selected locations within the World of Plants , while access to Supertree Grove requires admission to Christmas Wonderland .
 Singapore's skyline will also be transformed as part of the Singapore ARIRANG Light-up , running from 8 to 22 December , with landmarks illuminated in the signature red associated with BTS' latest album, ARIRANG .
 Participating locations include the Merlion , Singapore Flyer , The Helix Bridge , The Fullerton Hotel Singapore , Asian Civilisations Museum , Peranakan Museum , and several bridges along the Singapore River . The illuminations will generally run from 7 PM to 1 AM, with Gardens by the Bay lighting up from 11 PM.
 Over at The Kallang , the National Stadium roof will be illuminated from 8 to 22 December , while the Deloitte Sphere at OCBC Square will feature a BTS THE CITY ARIRANG installation during the same period. Fans can also visit the Feel Alive Zone at Stadium Riverside Walk from 9 to 22 December , featuring the Fan Chant Studio, Recharge Studio, Groove Studio, and a dedicated photo zone.
 The celebrations will extend to Universal Studios Singapore , where BTS-themed fireworks will illuminate the skies above Lake Hollywood on selected dates. Shows are scheduled for 4, 5, 11, and 12 December at 8 PM, followed by nightly displays from 16 to 25 December at 9 PM, except for 21 December , when a special edition will begin at 11:45 PM. Additional shows are planned for 1 and 2 January .
 The theme park will also introduce the BTS THE CITY ARIRANG Lightscape at its Ancient Egypt zone from 4 December to 3 January , alongside a special BTS THE CITY ARIRANG Night Out event on 21 December , running from 8 PM to 1 AM. Admission tickets are required for these experiences.
 On Sentosa , fans can look forward to the BTS THE CITY ARIRANG Rave & Drone Party at Palawan Green and Palawan Beach from 18 to 20 December . The ticketed event will feature live DJ performances beginning at 7:30 PM, followed by a drone show from 8:30 PM to 8:40 PM each evening.
 Other attractions on the island include a giant BTS-themed inflatable at Palawan Beach, interactive photo points at Central Beach Bazaar and Palawan Green, a tape hammock installation at Sensoryscape , and the BTS THE CITY ARIRANG RUN on 12 December , featuring an evening race and after-party.
 For fans looking to immerse themselves further, Resorts World Sentosa will host a dedicated BTS THE CITY ARIRANG Fan Village at the Resorts World Convention Centre from 16 to 22 December . Running daily from 11 AM to 10 PM, the ticketed experience will feature four themed areas: the Game Zone, Taste Zone, Beauty Zone, and Play Zone.
 Exclusive merchandise will also be available through BTS POP-UP : ARIRANG IN SINGAPORE , with two locations opening at National Gallery Singapore from 4 to 31 December and Resorts World Convention Centre from 16 to 22 December . Further details on participation and merchandise offerings will be announced separately.
 At National Gallery Singapore, fans can explore the Pop After Pop | BTS THE CITY ARIRANG Art Trail from 11 to 31 December , before returning after dark for the BTS THE CITY ARIRANG Gallery Rave on 18 and 19 December , from 8 PM to 11 PM.
 The National Museum of Singapore will also join the festivities with a facade light-up from 16 to 23 December , an interactive Dance Mirror experience throughout the month, and a Random Play Dance session with KPOP Dance Off on 18 December .
 Another newly revealed destination is New Bahru , where local creative brands will introduce BTS-themed products, menus, and experiences from 16 to 23 December . The takeover will also include themed photo booths, photo opportunities, and a stamp station.
 At Mandai Wildlife Reserve , visitors can explore BTS-themed installations at the East Plaza outside Singapore Zoo , alongside experiences at Exploria: A World in Connection , from 4 to 27 December .
 The celebration will continue into Singapore's nightlife scene, with Zouk Singapore hosting two special parties. Countdown Night will take place on 16 December , followed by Encore Night on 23 December , both running from 10 PM to 3 AM. BTS concert ticket holders will receive complimentary admission upon presentation of a valid ticket, subject to venue capacity and entry requirements.
 Fans can also celebrate aboard the Royal Albatross , which will offer BTS-themed dockside experiences at Resorts World Sentosa from 16 to 22 December . These include photo opportunities aboard the tall ship, themed dining experiences, and a nightly Cocktail Party on Deck featuring DJs, drinks, and canapés.
 Meanwhile, ARMY MADANG , taking place from 22 to 24 December , will offer an interactive CUSTOMIZE YOUR ARIRANG experience alongside a Samsung Galaxy Experience Booth and Photoism photo opportunities. Fans visiting the Samsung booth can receive limited-edition merchandise, create personalised stickers, and print photographs. Reservations will be required for ARMY MADANG, with its location and further details to be announced.
 The city-wide takeover will even extend to transport, dining, and shopping. Sentosa's cable cars and Sentosa Express will receive BTS-themed makeovers, while a specially decorated speedboat service will connect Marina South Pier , Ola Beach Club , and Resorts World Sentosa from 16 to 22 December .
 Fans can also look out for themed HelloRide bicycles across Singapore and a limited-edition SimplyGo BTS THE CITY EZ-Link card , available from 8 December at selected MRT stations and Changi Airport vending machines.
 Food and beverage collaborations will include special offerings from Starbucks , CHAGEE , and Raffles Hotel Singapore , with the latter introducing an ARIRANG Sling and themed dining selections. Participating restaurants at National Gallery Singapore and Mandai Wildlife Reserve will also join the celebration.
 Beyond these experiences, fans can visit Orchard Central for the BTS THE CITY Holiday Escape , featuring immersive photo moments and exclusive gifts with qualifying purchases, while Clarke Quay Central will host a Holiday Message Zone where visitors can create keepsakes and leave messages.
 Selected activations will form part of a city-wide Stamp Rally , encouraging ARMY to explore multiple destinations throughout Singapore. Further information on participation and rewards will be announced.
 BTS THE CITY ARIRANG SINGAPORE marks the project's first and only Southeast Asian stop this year, bringing the group's music and message beyond the concert stage to some of Singapore's most recognisable landmarks and attractions.
 With experiences spanning everything from light shows and beach parties to themed transportation and dining, the month-long celebration promises to turn Singapore into a playground for ARMY as BTS close out the year with their highly anticipated Singapore concerts.
 Fans can find the full programme, including individual event timings, admission requirements, and the latest updates, through the official Weverse announcement . Some experiences require separate tickets or advance reservations, while schedules may be subject to change.
